# `policy/` — DOCX with date-sensitive content

**Manifest id:** `travel-policy-v3` · **File:** `travel-policy-v3.docx` · **Status:** AUTHORED — generated by `../../../tools/generate_corpus.py`

## Retrieval property exercised

**Date-sensitive answers.** The document states two sets of rates: the current ones in the body,
and the superseded ones in a dated appendix. Both are in scope, both are indexed, and both are
retrievable by the same query.

The failure this catches is subtle and common: a bot that retrieves the appendix and answers
with the 2025 per-diem is *grounded* — the number really is in the sources, faithfulness scores
fine, the citation is valid — and it is wrong. Groundedness metrics cannot see this. The
deterministic half catches it through `required_facts` / `forbidden_claims`, which is why those
fields exist on a case and why they are not optional here.

The mirror-image failure matters too: asked about a trip that ended *before* the effective date,
the correct answer is the appendix value. A bot that always prefers the newest text fails that
one. Two cases, opposite directions, same document.

## What the fixture must contain

A ~6-page DOCX using real Word heading styles.

**Header block, on page 1, unambiguous:**

> **Travel and Expenses Policy — Version 3**
> Effective **2026-04-01**. Supersedes the policy dated **2025-01-15**.
> Next scheduled review: **2028-04-01** (this policy is reviewed every 24 months).

**Body sections and their load-bearing facts:**

| § | Heading | Facts |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Scope | Applies to all employees and to contractors travelling at Kelpwright's request. |
| 2 | Approval | Advance written approval is required for any single trip whose total estimated cost exceeds **1,200 EUR**. |
| 3 | Air travel | Economy is mandatory for scheduled flight time **under 6 hours**. Premium economy is permitted at **6 hours or more**. Business class requires an executive exception. |
| 4 | Subsistence (per diem) | Effective **2026-04-01**: domestic **62 EUR per day**, international **88 EUR per day**. Half rate on days of departure and return. |
| 5 | Private vehicle | **0.34 EUR per kilometre**, effective 2026-04-01. |
| 6 | Claims | Claims must be submitted within **30 days** of the trip end date. Claims submitted later require line-manager and finance approval. |
| 7 | Accommodation | Booked through the corporate agent; no nightly cap is stated. |
| A | **Appendix A — Superseded rates** | Explicitly headed *"Rates applicable to travel completed before 2026-04-01 (policy dated 2025-01-15)"*: domestic **55 EUR per day**, international **80 EUR per day**, mileage **0.31 EUR per kilometre**. |

Appendix A must state its date range **in the appendix's own text**, not only in its heading —
a chunk that carries the numbers without the qualifier is a chunk the bot can cite honestly and
wrongly, and the chunker is free to split at the heading.

## What the fixture must NOT contain

- No annual-leave, working-hours, or notice-period content — that is `handbook/`'s subject, and
  duplicating it would make ambiguous case `a-004` resolve by accident.
- No third rate set, and no "proposed rates for 2027". Exactly two eras, cleanly dated.
- No accommodation nightly cap: case `a-004` and human review both rely on §7 being genuinely
  silent on the number rather than vague about it.

`f-004`, `d-001` `d-002` `d-003`, `s-001`, `a-004`.
